findings.body: New evidence beyond the previous expiry finding: `review.task()` reads the live story branch's document (`src/forge/review.py:110–115`), but `fingerprint()` hashes the document from the task commit (`src/forge/review.py:160–166`). After accepting a task's stopped review, changing its Scope or Tests row on `story/<key>` leaves both acceptance fingerprints unchanged. Close and land can therefore reuse the accepted review and prepare the task for merge without reviewing its new requirements, contrary to the ruling that acceptance covers only the reviewed scope. The same omission affects the initial `--resolve accept` guard at close.py:82. Compare the effective scope used by the reviewer in both guards and add a command regression test that edits the story branch after acceptance; the current acceptance tests exercise fixes only.
findings.title: Expire acceptance when the story branch changes the task's scope
